_comment: Optional override for the registry-proof plan job (bin/last-stack-registry-proof-plan select-build). `target` null means: prove against the newest build in registry/next.json (the build the registry already pins for the Mac). Set target to {"build": "<git describe build>", "fold_oid": "<optional 40-hex>"} to prove a build that has no row yet, for example after a hand rollback. fold_oid empty = resolved from the build's short oid through the GitHub fold repo. Design: brain design-registry-proof-in-github-ci-20260930 (D4).
